cross-013.answer: Skiff runs Tern at the Performance preset, not the lowest (Ultra Performance, which is offered only in Meridian's 120 Hz mode), and it saves 1.8 ms over Quality (2.1 ms vs 3.9 ms). See dec-run-tern-on-skiff-at-the-performance-preset--74eqayfa83ybqpe3, which is still accepted and was reaffirmed by dec-lower-the-skiff-dynamic-resolution-floor-to-504p--15esnt90gcn29enn; the timings come from fnd-tern-costs-3-9-ms-at-quality-and-2-1-ms-at-perfo--dkbskbqfgfwtryq0.

cross-015.answer: Two Efforts are no longer active. The Co-op rollback netcode prototype was abandoned: the Decision dec-abandon-rollback-netcode-for-co-op--46envrg0v4pdwv7b stopped the prototype because tide re-simulation costs 4.8 ms on Skiff, so co-op will not ship with rollback. The Shader compile cache and build farm is completed: fnd-retrospective-on-the-shader-compile-cache--9rpv2a60ach04cx6 records that the cache has run on every farm build for five weeks, with a 94% steady-state hit rate and a warm clean rebuild of 6 min 40 s, down from 47 minutes.

netcode-004.answer: The team abandoned rollback because co-op tides must stay bit-identical across peers, so every rolled-back frame must re-run the tide step, costing 4.8 ms on Skiff (about a fifth of the 25 ms frame), and the quarter-resolution workaround desynced within 90 seconds (dec-abandon-rollback-netcode-for-co-op--46envrg0v4pdwv7b). The reason depends on the world Decision dec-run-the-tide-simulation-in-32-32-fixed-point--c5rjfcnmhne4h05e.

ports-012.answer: Caustics under saltglass shimmered badly at the 540p floor even with Tern (visible in 7 of 10 dune views; 2 of 10 at 576p), so the team raised the floor to 576p, per `dec-raise-the-skiff-dynamic-resolution-floor-to-576p--fep9q7m08pp9f0bb`, citing `fnd-saltglass-caustics-shimmer-at-the-540p-floor--0aa8sts89vhq1s6q`. That 576p decision was later superseded by `dec-lower-the-skiff-dynamic-resolution-floor-to-504p--15esnt90gcn29enn`.

ports-013.answer: Ship Tern as Lantern's only upscaler

render-031.answer: Alpha-tested foliage cost 2.1 ms in the visibility buffer versus 0.8 ms in forward+, because the alpha test runs in the raster pass with a per-pixel texture fetch, and saltglass refracts what is behind it so it needs the resolved scene first. (dec-visibility-buffer-for-opaque-geometry-foliage-an--gvnvp04jgm7kbfh9; based on fnd-alpha-tested-foliage-costs-2-1-ms-in-the-visibil--f3g34x2k6fs367eb)

render-032.answer: Tern was chosen as Lantern's only upscaler (dec-ship-tern-as-lantern-s-only-upscaler--fmreq35nzyjc7k4e) because Halcyon has no Skiff build, so shipping it on two platforms would break the one-upscaler constraint, and because owning the upscaler code matters more for saltglass than raw quality, since refraction and per-frame caustics need upscaler changes the team can make itself rather than vendor tickets.

render-046.answer: The cost Finding that had sunk virtual shadow maps was a capture error; with cached pages VSM costs 1.4 ms, less than four cascades, and cascade seams through saltglass remain unsolved under CSM (dec-use-virtual-shadow-maps-for-the-sun--x8nqkn9q7eaf1ap4, reopened 2026-01-12 after being rejected_by dec-use-cascaded-shadow-maps-with-four-cascades--s5c1y9jaf275afzr).

render-047.answer: dec-visibility-buffer-on-all-platforms-skiff-resolve--k1ackk3c3275r5y1: a release-build capture put the visibility buffer on Skiff at 7.4 ms against 8.1 ms for forward+ (6.3 ms with half-rate material resolve), so the forward+ fallback was no longer worth keeping. The earlier 11.2 ms Skiff number came from a capture with GPU validation on and was invalidated by fnd-visibility-buffer-costs-7-4-ms-on-skiff-in-a-rel--fs86h16tm5hgempd.

world-036.answer: Kestrel retired the fiber scheduler because 41% of alpha crash reports had no usable stack, which blocked crash triage for beta, and the continuation-wait thread pool kept workers 93% busy during tide turns, close to the 95% fibers gave, so fibers' two points of utilisation did not justify unreadable crashes and the Gull thread-local bug. (dec-return-engine-jobs-to-a-thread-pool-with-continu--1zkc1v2x97taf50h)

world-051.answer: Integer adds and multiplies in 32.32 fixed point give the same bits on every CPU and compiler, so the drift that float tides showed between machines within 6 minutes cannot happen (dec-run-the-tide-simulation-in-32-32-fixed-point--c5rjfcnmhne4h05e; the strict IEEE option, dec-force-strict-ieee-float-mode-for-the-tide-simula--ecwmqt7ncjngysqw, was rejected by it).

world-055.answer: Kelp stays because the team kept it and shipped a 1 MB dictionary on every platform, which beats Zstandard by 1.7x with a cold cache on Skiff; this closes the reopened Zstandard option. Record: dec-shrink-kelp-s-dictionary-to-1-mb-for-streamed-as--yh8hktfqnyqhepew
